description: Places an order for one test from the tester catalogue. A person performs it and returns a recorded walkthrough with a screenshot and the console output of every step, plus their written findings. It suits a specific doubt only a person can resolve; a brief that says what is suspected produces a sharper report. Charges the offer's price at purchase and releases it if no tester accepts within 72 hours. offer_id identifies an offer in the tester catalogue. Cost: set by the offer you choose — the tester catalogue states each offer's price in credits, its turnaround, and exactly what is delivered. Charged when the order is placed and released if no tester accepts within 72 hours, or if the tester who accepted misses the offer's turnaround. Rate limit: 100 requests/minute per API key.

brief.description: What to test and what would count as a problem. At least 20 characters. Example: 'Check the mobile checkout on iPhone — I think the pay button falls below the fold.'

offer_id.description: The offer's id, as listed in the tester catalogue

target_url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page to test

name: hire_tester
